article.headline: Lipscomb defeats Jacksonville 76-57
article.description: Grant Asman scored 11 points as Lipscomb beat Jacksonville 76-57 on Thursday.
article.story: Grant Asman scored 11 points as Lipscomb beat Jacksonville 76-57 on Thursday. Asman had five rebounds and three steals for the Bisons (8-6, 1-0 Atlantic Sun Conference). Titas Sargiunas added 10 points while going 4 of 10 (2 for 5 from 3-point range). Chris Arias led the Dolphins (5-9, 0-1) in scoring, finishing with 13 points off the bench. Donovan Rivers added 10 points and 10 rebounds for Jacksonville. Chris Lockett Jr. had 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
